note: Names and descriptions are PlayStation's official list as carried by the kit starter and verified against Exophase (all 55 descriptions matched in order). Hidden flags follow the 28-hidden / 27-visible split reported by ofzenandcomputing and EGamers. Gamerscore uses the 180/90/30/10 scale (Platinum 180, Gold 90, Silver 30, Bronze 10) totalling exactly 1,000G. PSN points use the 300/90/30/15 scale totalling 1,350. No earn-rate percentages are published anywhere, so none are shown; rarity order is grade then Gamerscore.

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. There is no shortcut: it pops the moment your 54th trophy lands, which for most players is A Long Road at 100% completion.
trophies.hint: Earn the other 54 trophies — it pops last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then map and collectibles, then activities and challenges, then crime and cleanup.
Save A Long Road (100% completion) for last — it is the usual final step.
The platinum pops automatically the moment the 54th trophy is earned.

trophies.guide: The first trophy of the game. Gone Fishing is the opening mission — play it to the end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.hint: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening.
Follow the on-screen objectives through Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops at the chapter's end — nothing to hunt, just play.
trophies.hint: Play through Chapter 1 to its end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the story missions in order through Chapter 1.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.hint: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play the story missions in order through Chapter 2.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.hint: Play through Chapter 3 to its end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play the story missions in order through Chapter 3.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.hint: Play through Chapter 4 to its end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play the story missions in order through Chapter 4.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Story gold. Finish the final mission and the campaign ends with this trophy. Some guide sites word it as Chapter 5; the official description says the final mission, so that is what to trust.
trophies.hint: Finish the final mission of the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: EGamers — trophy list (notes the wording differs across sources)
steps: Play the story through to its final mission.
Finish the final mission.
The gold pops at the end of the campaign.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy. Play the story until Breakfast Run appears, then finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy. Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy. Play the story until Child's Play appears, then finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy. Play the story until Headliners appears, then finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy. Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears, then finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy. Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears, then finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission unlocks.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: The hardest gold and the usual final trophy before the platinum. The 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made earlier counts, and nothing on it is missable.
trophies.hint: Reach 100% completion — the last big push.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist opens after it.
Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work down the list.
Note the big counts: 300 of 397 stunts, all 42 Top Fun races, and 70 of 80 Challenges count toward 100%.
Clear the last item and the gold pops; the platinum follows at once.

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida. Only 250 count for the trophy, but 300 count toward 100%, so keep going after it pops if you want the platinum.
trophies.hint: Land 250 stunt jumps across Leonida.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: GTA Zone — stunt counts (250 of 397; 300 for 100%)
steps: Find stunt jumps on the map — ramps, gaps and jumps are marked as you explore.
Land 250 of them; a fast bike or car helps on the long ones.
Failed jumps do not count, so retry until the landing sticks.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample everything. Play one round of each of the 9 activity types — races, fishing, bowling, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races and the rest — and the trophy pops after the ninth type.
trophies.hint: Play one round of every activity type.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the map and look for activity icons.
Play one round of each of the 9 activity types.
The trophy pops after the ninth different type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Each challenge scores on accuracy and speed, so learn the weapon each one wants before you chase the gold.
trophies.hint: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges.
Gold every challenge — 42 in total.
Use the weapon the challenge is built for and steady your aim; retries are free.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per spot is enough for the trophy; all 42 races count toward 100%.
trophies.hint: Win one drone race at each of the 14 spots.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun venues on the map — 14 spots in total.
Win one drone race at each spot.
Fly tight lines and cut the corners; the drone handles like a fast boat, not a car.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count, so work through the race list across Leonida — street, off-road and whatever else the map offers.
trophies.hint: Win 20 distinct races — repeats do not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races across Leonida.
Win 20 distinct ones — the same race twice counts once.
Upgrade your car between races if a series keeps beating you.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him — a bigger catch or more fish than he lands.
trophies.hint: Out-fish Cal in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal and accept his fishing challenge.
Fish against him and land the better catch.
The trophy pops when you beat his score.

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet anywhere in Leonida and play one game through to its end.
trophies.hint: Finish any arcade cabinet game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Start a game and play it to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish Andy's last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy's strand and play his missions in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish Kenton's last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton's strand and play his missions in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish Billy's last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy's strand and play his missions in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands. Guide sites report that only some strangers count toward the eight — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are named as counting, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not — so start with the named ones and keep a count as you go.
trophies.hint: Finish 8 stranger mission strands.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger markers across Leonida.
Complete full strands — a single mission does not count.
Guide sites name Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as counting strands; finish eight of those first.
The trophy pops after the eighth strand completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish Randy's last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy's strand and play his missions in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and finish it.
trophies.hint: Finish Tyrone's last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone's strand and play his missions in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots in the 10 meditation locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy guide sites flag as possibly missable: GTABase and PowerPyx both warn it may be, so do not leave the spots for post-game — clear them as you find them, and keep a manual save before story beats that could lock an area.
trophies.hint: Meditate at all 18 spots — possibly missable!
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Find the meditation spots — 18 spots across 10 locations.
Meditate at each one, with Jason and Lucia where the spot needs both.
Do them as you find them, not in post-game: this is the only trophy flagged as possibly missable.
Keep a manual save before big story beats, just in case a spot locks.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunt and track down the unique animal he wants, then bring it down.
trophies.hint: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Meet Bret and take the hunt.
Track the unique animal to its area.
Hunt it down to complete the job.

trophies.guide: Collect cards across Leonida and complete three full sets. Cards hide in shops, houses and odd corners, so sweep each area as you pass through it.
trophies.hint: Complete 3 full collectible card sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore — shops, houses and odd corners.
Track which sets are close to complete and hunt the missing cards.
Complete three full sets and the silver pops.

trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app and use it at 100 different spots. Any spot counts once, so keep moving — a road trip with the app open knocks out dozens.
trophies.hint: Use the WAiNK app at 100 spots.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone.
Use it at 100 different locations — each spot counts once.
Drive a route through towns and landmarks and use it everywhere you stop.

trophies.guide: Clear any 50 of the 80 Challenges on the map. Seventy count toward 100%, so keep going after this pops if you are chasing the platinum.
trophies.hint: Clear 50 of the 80 map challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges list and pick the easy ones first.
Clear any 50 — combat, driving and exploration challenges all count.
The trophy pops at 50; keep going to 70 for the 100% push.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops together and escape. A quiet stretch of road and a fast car make the getaway easy.
trophies.hint: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along and stir up trouble until you hit 4 stars.
Break line of sight — alleys, tunnels and off-road help.
Stay hidden until the stars clear and you escape together.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between hits. Pick three shops close together and plan the route before the first robbery.
trophies.hint: Rob 3 shops in a row, keeping the wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and scout the route.
Rob the first with your partner, then move straight to the next.
Keep the wanted level alive between hits — do not lose the cops until all three are done.

trophies.guide: Get in or scan 100 different vehicles. Variety is what counts — the same model twice adds nothing, so keep trying new ones as you spot them.
trophies.hint: Discover 100 different vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive or scan every new vehicle you spot — cars, bikes, boats, planes.
Each new model counts once; repeats add nothing.
Hang around traffic-heavy areas and car parks to find rare ones.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Line up five enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. A crowded fight with weak enemies is the place to try it.
trophies.hint: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Drop five of them before the focus ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport and leave in an unscheduled way. Public sources have not pinned the exact trigger down yet — the working lead is taking off from the runway in a stolen aircraft.
trophies.hint: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Get to VCIA airport.
Make an unscheduled departure — the working lead is stealing an aircraft and taking off from the runway.
If it does not pop, try another aircraft or runway; the exact trigger is not pinned down in public sources yet.

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. Public sources have not pinned the exact trigger down yet — the working lead is destroying a Rhino, or surviving one's attention long enough for the game to notice.
trophies.hint: Deal with the Rhino tanks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank — they show up at high wanted levels and military spots.
Deal with it: the working lead is destroying one.
If it does not pop, try surviving a Rhino's attention instead; the exact trigger is not pinned down in public sources yet.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clear a jewelry store with no alarms and no witnesses. Go quiet: mask up, move at night if you can, and get out before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.hint: Rob a jewelry store unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Case a jewelry store and watch its staff and cameras.
Get in, take the goods and get out with no alarms.
If anyone spots you, restart the job — detection voids it.

trophies.guide: Rob five of the eight bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault brings a 4-star response, so have a fast bike ready before you crack the first one.
trophies.hint: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: GTA Zone — 5 of 8 vaults; optional Chapter 4 mission; 4 stars every time
steps: Unlock the vaults through the optional Chapter 4 mission.
Hit five of the eight vaults.
Every vault brings 4 stars, so park a fast bike nearby and plan the getaway first.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and lose the pursuit.
trophies.hint: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck driving its route.
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape the pursuit that follows.

trophies.guide: Reveal every one of the 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the map until nothing is left unrevealed — the map itself shows you what is missing.
trophies.hint: Reveal all 52 areas of Leonida.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through every named area of Leonida.
Check the map for regions still unrevealed and drive through them.
The trophy pops when the last area is revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation for every one of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations, so work the list gang by gang.
trophies.hint: Hit one illegal operation per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find illegal operations on the map.
Rob one belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean Beach spot and have a cocktail with the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — just show up and order.
trophies.hint: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean Beach spot.
Order a cocktail with the view.
The trophy pops as you enjoy it.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom and drive a car straight through its glass in classic GTA style.
trophies.hint: Drive a car through a showroom window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get a car inside or lined up at the glass.
Drive straight through the showroom window.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game through to the end.
trophies.hint: Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game — follow through to the last frame.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.guide: A story moment with your partner. Public sources have not pinned the exact trigger down yet — it unlocks during the campaign, so keep playing the story with your partner and it will come.
trophies.hint: A story moment with your partner.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Keep playing the story with your partner.
The trophy unlocks at a story moment — the exact trigger is not pinned down in public sources yet.
If you are past the story and it has not popped, check the partner missions you may have skipped.

trophies.guide: Story choices. PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one, so keep making choices whenever the story offers them and it will land.
trophies.hint: Keep making story choices (PSN counts to 500).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: kit starter — PSN tracks a count to 500
steps: Make choices whenever the story offers them.
PlayStation tracks a count to 500 behind this trophy.
Keep choosing and it pops on its own.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A story moment where the second try is the one that lands — if something fails once, retry it.
trophies.hint: Succeed on a second try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play the story and watch for a moment that fails first time.
Retry it — the second try is the charm.
The trophy pops on the successful second attempt.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. A story moment tied to the weird side of Leonida — explore odd spots and random events and it will find you.
trophies.hint: Witness something strange in Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore the odd corners of Leonida and its random events.
Keep an eye out for something strange.
The trophy pops when you witness it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle, then knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Slow down just enough to land the hit.
trophies.hint: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the car.
The trophy pops when the drive-by connects.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists, then launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. The bills pile up fast once the vaults and trucks start paying.
trophies.hint: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Keep going until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida — weapons, clothes, cars, food, it all counts. Big purchases like cars get you there fastest.
trophies.hint: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend at any shop — weapons, clothes, cars and food all count.
Big purchases move the total fastest.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map. Save up, then work through the for-sale list one garage at a time.
trophies.hint: Buy all 8 garage properties.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find garage properties for sale on the map.
Buy all 8 of them.
The trophy pops on the last purchase.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 different vehicles. Any vehicle you drive counts — just keep registering new ones.
trophies.hint: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 different vehicles through it.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
